scoring_justification: DFT recompute from raw orbital output is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; result-level comparison against paper-reported DFT gap (2.5 eV) with tolerance appropriate for independent open-source DFT re-run.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold HOMO-LUMO gap from the paper's DFT band structure calculation
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: "...which are separated by ~2.5 eV in the band structure diagram."
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's band structure discussion; value is the theoretical gap for the same calculation (B3LYP/6-31G, Mn²⁺ sextet).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly taken from the paper's reported computed band gap; it is the reference value the reproduction must match within tolerance.

outputs.description: The HOMO-LUMO energy gap computed from the DFT calculation.

output_contract.notes: Only the DFT HOMO-LUMO gap is reproduced; experimental band gaps and crystal structure refinement are not within scope.

steps.description: Check that the reported HOMO-LUMO gap is within 0.3 eV of the paper's computed value (2.5 eV). Full credit if |value - 2.5| <= 0.3.
